# Jake Steinberg — cartographer, Minneapolis

> Jake Steinberg is a cartographer, GIS analyst and data journalist in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and a graphics reporter at the Minnesota Star Tribune. He is the author of *The Twin Cities in 50 Maps* (Belt Publishing, 2026) and an editor of the *Atlas of Design*. He takes on a small number of freelance map commissions each year.

## Freelance commissions

Jake takes on freelance commissions alongside his job at the Star Tribune:

- Print reference and trail maps
- Wall, poster and trailhead maps
- Analytical and data-driven maps for reports and publications
- 3D terrain and relief
- Illustrated and hand-drawn maps

Every project starts with a short call and a written quote; rates depend on scope. To ask about one, email jakesteinberg96@gmail.com or use the form on the [contact page](https://www.jakesteinberg.com/contact.html).

## About

- Graphics reporter, Minnesota Star Tribune (2023–present): maps and data graphics for the news
- Previously: graphics intern at The Wall Street Journal; cartographer and interim production manager at the UW Cartography Lab, making maps for clients such as The Nature Conservancy and Wisconsin Sea Grant
- M.S. in Cartography and GIS, University of Wisconsin–Madison; B.A. in Journalism, University of Minnesota
- Tools and skills: cartographic design, GIS analysis, data visualization, 3D terrain, illustrated maps, interactive and web maps

### Operation Metro Surge (2026)

Tags: News, Interactive, Scrollytelling

Provided authoritative visual journalism on the unprecedented and rapidly unfolding immigration operation that ultimately left two U.S. citizens dead and ignited a protest movement watched by the world.

Award: Winner, Breaking News, Large Newsroom, from the Online News Association’s Online Journalism Awards 2026. Finalist for the Knight Award for Public Service.

- [Breaking down the videos: A close examination of the shooting of Renee Good](https://www.startribune.com/breaking-down-the-videos-a-close-examination-of-the-shooting-of-renee-good/601560158)
- [How 3,000 federal agents would compare to 10 largest Twin Cities police forces](https://www.startribune.com/how-ice-numbers-compare-to-twin-cities-largest-police-forces/601562617)
- [A chaotic confrontation, a gun and 10 shots: A frame-by-frame analysis of the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti](https://www.startribune.com/a-chaotic-confrontation-a-gun-and-10-shots-a-frame-by-frame-analysis-of-the-fatal-shooting-of-alex-pretti/601570463)
- [Is ICE really leaving Minnesota? The data is complicated.](https://www.startribune.com/is-ice-really-pulling-out-of-minnesota-observer-data-tells-a-complicated-story/601580496)

### Slivers of an Ancient Forest (2021)

Tags: Print, Illustrated, Outdoors

The Northwoods are as fundamental to the cultural identity of the Upper Midwest as lakes and mosquitos. I made this National Geographic-inspired poster map for GEOG 370: Intro to Cartography. It tells the story of what the Northwoods used to be, as well as what they might one day become.

Award: CaGIS Arthur Robinson Award for best print map, 2022

Award: Featured in the NACIS Atlas of Design, Vol. VI

Award: Winner in Research, NACIS Student Map & Poster Competition, 2022

Award: Barbara Petchenik Award, best graduate student map, UW–Madison, 2022

- [View the full map](https://www.jakesteinberg.com/img/slivers-of-an-ancient-forest-sml.png)

### Immigration in the Twin Cities (2026)

Tags: Print

Dot density maps that create a mosaic of immigrant communities in the Twin Cities at two points in history.

- [In the book: The Twin Cities in 50 Maps](https://beltpublishing.com/products/the-twin-cities-in-50-maps)

### Work for the Wall Street Journal (2023)

Tags: News, Scrollytelling

- [War in Ukraine](https://www.wsj.com/story/the-strategic-importance-of-the-russia-controlled-land-bridge-in-ukraine-832d0728?mod=hp_lead_pos7)

### Where is Uptown? (2025)

Tags: News, Interactive, Print

A crowdsourced community geography story about Minneapolis’s most argued-over district. Or, neighborhood? Maybe vibe?

Award: Awards of Excellence in Infographics; Line of Coverage; and Use of Multimedia and Design Elements, Society for News Design, 2026. It contributed to a portfolio Bronze Medal for my excellent editor, C.J. Sinner.

- [Where is Uptown?](https://www.startribune.com/where-is-uptown-help-us-settle-the-debate-by-drawing-your-boundaries/601438173)

Tags: Print, Outdoors

### The Life and Death of the Great Lakes Pipeline (2023)

Tags: Scrollytelling, Climate

Taking place in the all-too-near future, this piece of speculative fiction I made for Rob Roth’s Graphic Design in Cartography course tells the story of a pipeline that exports water from the Great Lakes to an increasingly thirsty world.

Award: Best student map, Wisconsin Land Information Association, 2023

- [Open the project](https://www.jakesteinberg.com/pipeline.html)
